sourceTitle: Setting a new standard for responsible AI infrastructure
originalTitle: Setting a new standard for responsible AI infrastructure
author: OpenAI

blocks.text: The promise of AI is that it gives people more power to shape their own futures. It can help someone learn a new skill, build a business, or solve a problem that was previously out of reach. Building more computing infrastructure capacity in the United States can help lower the cost of delivering AI, put these tools in more people’s hands, and ensure America stays at the forefront of the technology.
blocks.en: The promise of AI is that it gives people more power to shape their own futures. It can help someone learn a new skill, build a business, or solve a problem that was previously out of reach. Building more computing infrastructure capacity in the United States can help lower the cost of delivering AI, put these tools in more people’s hands, and ensure America stays at the forefront of the technology.
blocks.zh: AI 的潜力在于，它能赋予人们塑造未来的能力。它可以帮助人们学习新技能、创业，或解决过去无力解决的问题。在美国扩大计算基础设施容量，有助于降低 AI 服务的交付成本，让更多人用上这些工具，并确保美国在这项技术上保持领先优势。

blocks.text: The communities that host this infrastructure should have a clear say in shaping their futures, too. Residents should be able to influence how a campus is developed, hold developers accountable for covering the cost of powering it, and share in the jobs and business opportunities it creates. How we build these campuses is one of the first tests of whether the benefits of AI will be broadly shared.
blocks.en: The communities that host this infrastructure should have a clear say in shaping their futures, too. Residents should be able to influence how a campus is developed, hold developers accountable for covering the cost of powering it, and share in the jobs and business opportunities it creates. How we build these campuses is one of the first tests of whether the benefits of AI will be broadly shared.
blocks.zh: 这些基础设施所在的社区，也应在塑造自身未来方面拥有明确的话语权。居民应当能够影响园区的开发方式，督促开发方承担园区供电成本，并分享园区带来的就业和商业机会。我们如何建设这些园区，正是检验 AI 红利能否广泛共享的首个考验。

blocks.text: Today we’re publishing our National Community Compact and a Compute Campus Policy Blueprint. The compact sets out what communities can expect from OpenAI at future campuses that we own and operate. The blueprint proposes policies to help ensure that compute campus development gives communities a meaningful voice, protects families from new costs, and broadly shares the economic gains of AI.
blocks.en: Today we’re publishing our National Community Compact and a Compute Campus Policy Blueprint. The compact sets out what communities can expect from OpenAI at future campuses that we own and operate. The blueprint proposes policies to help ensure that compute campus development gives communities a meaningful voice, protects families from new costs, and broadly shares the economic gains of AI.
blocks.zh: 今天，我们发布了《全国社区公约》和《算力园区政策蓝图》。公约明确了以下内容：对于 OpenAI 未来拥有并运营的园区，所在社区可以期待我们履行哪些承诺。蓝图则提出了一系列政策建议，旨在确保社区在算力园区开发过程中拥有实质性话语权，保护家庭免于承担新增成本，并广泛共享 AI 创造的经济收益。

blocks.text: This builds on work we began in January, when we announced our Stargate Community commitments to pay our own way on energy and develop plans shaped by local priorities. We followed with specific commitments in Georgia and Ohio, covering energy costs, water use, local investment and accountability. Throughout that work, we’ve listened to residents, local leaders, schools and businesses about what matters to their communities. Today’s announcement is the next step in that ongoing effort.
blocks.en: This builds on work we began in January, when we announced our Stargate Community commitments to pay our own way on energy and develop plans shaped by local priorities. We followed with specific commitments in Georgia and Ohio, covering energy costs, water use, local investment and accountability. Throughout that work, we’ve listened to residents, local leaders, schools and businesses about what matters to their communities. Today’s announcement is the next step in that ongoing effort.
blocks.zh: 这项举措进一步推进了今年 1 月启动的工作。当时，我们公布了 Stargate 社区承诺，承诺自行承担能源成本，并根据当地的优先事项制定计划。随后，我们又在佐治亚州和俄亥俄州作出了具体承诺，涵盖能源成本、用水、当地投资和问责机制。在整个过程中，我们一直在倾听居民、当地领导者、学校和企业的意见，了解各个社区最关心的事情。今天公布的内容，标志着这项长期工作迈出了下一步。

blocks.text: Our commitments to the communities where we build
blocks.en: Our commitments to the communities where we build
blocks.zh: 我们对园区所在社区的承诺

blocks.text: Every future compute campus OpenAI owns and operates will have its own local compact. We’ll engage residents early enough to ensure their input shapes project plans, give them a local point of contact throughout the life of the campus, and report publicly each year on how we’re doing. Each compact will reflect local priorities and include a common set of commitments:
blocks.en: Every future compute campus OpenAI owns and operates will have its own local compact. We’ll engage residents early enough to ensure their input shapes project plans, give them a local point of contact throughout the life of the campus, and report publicly each year on how we’re doing. Each compact will reflect local priorities and include a common set of commitments:
blocks.zh: 未来，OpenAI 拥有并运营的每个算力园区，都将制定适用于当地的社区公约。我们将尽早让居民参与，确保他们的意见能影响项目规划；在园区的整个存续期间设立当地联络人，并每年公开报告承诺的落实情况。每份公约都将体现当地的优先事项，并包含以下共同承诺：

blocks.text: Pay our own way on energy and infrastructure. We’ll pay the full cost of the electricity we use and the infrastructure needed to serve us. Before major spending begins, we’ll provide financial assurances so other customers are protected if a project is delayed, reduced, or canceled.
blocks.en: Pay our own way on energy and infrastructure. We’ll pay the full cost of the electricity we use and the infrastructure needed to serve us. Before major spending begins, we’ll provide financial assurances so other customers are protected if a project is delayed, reduced, or canceled.
blocks.zh: 自行承担能源和基础设施成本。我们将全额承担自身用电以及配套基础设施的成本。在大额支出出现前，我们将提供财务担保，确保即使项目延期、缩减或取消，其他客户也不会因此承担损失。

blocks.text: Protect local resources and report on our impact. We’ll develop a water plan for each campus, prioritize closed-loop or low-water cooling, and publish site-level water and electricity use. We’ll publish construction plans and independent noise studies before operations begin and annually afterward. And we will not use non-disclosure agreements (NDAs) with public officials, allowing only narrow protections covering legitimate security information, trade secrets, or proprietary or competitively sensitive information.
blocks.en: Protect local resources and report on our impact. We’ll develop a water plan for each campus, prioritize closed-loop or low-water cooling, and publish site-level water and electricity use. We’ll publish construction plans and independent noise studies before operations begin and annually afterward. And we will not use non-disclosure agreements (NDAs) with public officials, allowing only narrow protections covering legitimate security information, trade secrets, or proprietary or competitively sensitive information.
blocks.zh: 保护当地资源，报告我们造成的影响。我们将为每个园区制定用水计划，优先采用闭环或低耗水冷却系统，并公布各园区的用水量和用电量。我们将在运营开始前公布施工计划和独立噪声研究报告，此后每年公布一次。此外，我们不会与公职人员签订保密协议 (NDA)，仅对确有必要保密的安全信息、商业秘密、专有信息或竞争敏感信息采取范围严格受限的保护措施。

blocks.text: Create opportunities for local workers and businesses. We’ll publish the jobs we expect to create, work with unions and training providers to help residents prepare for them, and report annually on hiring and apprenticeships. We’ll also make sustained investments in priorities residents help select.
blocks.en: Create opportunities for local workers and businesses. We’ll publish the jobs we expect to create, work with unions and training providers to help residents prepare for them, and report annually on hiring and apprenticeships. We’ll also make sustained investments in priorities residents help select.
blocks.zh: 为当地劳动者和企业创造机会。我们将公布计划新增的就业岗位，与工会和培训机构合作，帮助居民做好应聘这些岗位的准备，并每年报告招聘及学徒培养情况。我们还将持续投资由居民共同选定的优先事项。

blocks.text: Those priorities will differ from place to place. In Effingham County, Georgia, residents helped shape a $4.8 million grant to provide free school meals for all 14,000 students in the county. In Pike County, Ohio, families identified childcare as a priority, leading to a joint $6 million commitment from OpenAI and SB Energy.
blocks.en: Those priorities will differ from place to place. In Effingham County, Georgia, residents helped shape a $4.8 million grant to provide free school meals for all 14,000 students in the county. In Pike County, Ohio, families identified childcare as a priority, leading to a joint $6 million commitment from OpenAI and SB Energy.
blocks.zh: 这些优先事项因地而异。在佐治亚州埃芬汉县，居民参与制定了一项 480 万美元的资助计划，为全县 14,000 名学生提供免费校餐。在俄亥俄州派克县，当地家庭将儿童托育列为优先事项，促成了 OpenAI 和 SB Energy 共同作出 600 万美元的投入承诺。

blocks.text: A policy blueprint for responsible development
blocks.en: A policy blueprint for responsible development
blocks.zh: 推动负责任开发的政策蓝图

blocks.text: Families should be able to count on basic protections whoever builds a campus in their community. Voluntary commitments from companies are an important starting point, but our blueprint goes further—asking federal, state, and local policymakers to establish clear rules for how the industry builds. New policy is required to establish trust and confidence between communities, elected officials and companies. Lawmakers should establish rules to advance responsible investment, protect residents, and ensure that the benefits of AI infrastructure are broadly shared.
blocks.en: Families should be able to count on basic protections whoever builds a campus in their community. Voluntary commitments from companies are an important starting point, but our blueprint goes further—asking federal, state, and local policymakers to establish clear rules for how the industry builds. New policy is required to establish trust and confidence between communities, elected officials and companies. Lawmakers should establish rules to advance responsible investment, protect residents, and ensure that the benefits of AI infrastructure are broadly shared.
blocks.zh: 无论谁在社区建设园区，当地家庭都应享有可靠的基本保障。企业的自愿承诺是重要的起点，但我们的蓝图更进一步：呼吁联邦、州和地方政策制定者，为行业发展确立清晰规则。在新政策的支持下，社区、民选官员和企业之间才能建立信任与信心。立法者应制定规则，推动负责任的投资，保护居民，并确保 AI 基础设施带来的红利得到广泛共享。

blocks.text: That starts with who pays for power. State utility commissions should require large electricity customers to cover the costs they add to the grid and protect other customers if a project falls through. Utilities should also make it easier for campuses to connect if they can safely cut demand when power is scarce. At our planned Effingham County campus, for example, our agreement with Georgia Power allows the utility to reduce the power it delivers to us by up to 1,000 megawatts during periods of high demand. Congress can help meet growing demand by speeding up transmission upgrades and restoring and expanding tax incentives for clean electricity.
blocks.en: That starts with who pays for power. State utility commissions should require large electricity customers to cover the costs they add to the grid and protect other customers if a project falls through. Utilities should also make it easier for campuses to connect if they can safely cut demand when power is scarce. At our planned Effingham County campus, for example, our agreement with Georgia Power allows the utility to reduce the power it delivers to us by up to 1,000 megawatts during periods of high demand. Congress can help meet growing demand by speeding up transmission upgrades and restoring and expanding tax incentives for clean electricity.
blocks.zh: 首先要明确的是，谁来承担供电成本。各州公用事业委员会应要求用电大户承担其给电网带来的新增成本，并确保在项目未能落实时，保障其他客户的利益。对于能在电力紧缺时安全降低用电需求的园区，电力公司也应为其接入电网提供便利。例如，针对我们计划在埃芬汉县建设的园区，我们与佐治亚电力公司签订的协议允许该公司在用电高峰期将对我们的供电功率最多降低 1,000 兆瓦。国会可以加快输电设施升级，并恢复和扩大清洁电力税收优惠，以满足不断增长的需求。

blocks.text: Communities also need a way to hold developers accountable. The blueprint calls for public reporting on water, energy, noise, and hiring, and for narrow limits on when developers can require public officials to sign NDAs. When states or local governments offer tax incentives, the terms should be public, with measurable commitments and a way to recover benefits if a developer falls short.
blocks.en: Communities also need a way to hold developers accountable. The blueprint calls for public reporting on water, energy, noise, and hiring, and for narrow limits on when developers can require public officials to sign NDAs. When states or local governments offer tax incentives, the terms should be public, with measurable commitments and a way to recover benefits if a developer falls short.
blocks.zh: 社区也有必要制定计划以督促开发方履行责任。蓝图呼吁公开用水、能耗、噪声和招聘情况报告，并严格限定开发方要求公职人员签署保密协议的情形。州或地方政府提供税收优惠时，应公开相关条款，设定可衡量的承诺，并建立在开发方未达标时追回优惠的机制。

blocks.text: Finally, the blueprint proposes practical ways to keep more of the work local to ensure compute campuses support local workers and local businesses. Developers can share purchasing plans early enough for local suppliers to compete for contracts. Employers, building trades unions, and community colleges can use hiring forecasts to train residents for jobs they know will be available, from electrical work during construction to maintaining power and cooling systems for years afterward.
blocks.en: Finally, the blueprint proposes practical ways to keep more of the work local to ensure compute campuses support local workers and local businesses. Developers can share purchasing plans early enough for local suppliers to compete for contracts. Employers, building trades unions, and community colleges can use hiring forecasts to train residents for jobs they know will be available, from electrical work during construction to maintaining power and cooling systems for years afterward.
blocks.zh: 最后，蓝图还提出了切实可行的办法 — 将更多工作机会留在当地，确保算力园区支持当地劳动者和企业。开发方可以提前公布采购计划，为当地供应商留出足够时间参与竞标。雇主、建筑业工会和社区学院可以根据招聘预测，为居民提供针对明确岗位需求的培训，从施工期间的电气作业，到此后多年电力和冷却系统的维护。
以社区为出发点推进园区建设

blocks.text: The investments that help America compete globally can also help communities prosper locally. That starts with giving residents a say while plans can still change and a way to hold developers accountable for delivering on their commitments. That’s what we’re committing to at the campuses we own and operate, and what we believe people should be able to count on wherever AI infrastructure is built across the country.
blocks.en: The investments that help America compete globally can also help communities prosper locally. That starts with giving residents a say while plans can still change and a way to hold developers accountable for delivering on their commitments. That’s what we’re committing to at the campuses we own and operate, and what we believe people should be able to count on wherever AI infrastructure is built across the country.
blocks.zh: 帮助美国参与全球竞争的投资，同样可以促进当地社区繁荣。第一步，就是在计划仍可调整时，赋予居民话语权，并为他们提供督促开发方兑现承诺的途径。这正是我们在自有自营园区作出的承诺。我们也相信，无论 AI 基础设施在何处建设，人们都应获得同等保障。
